_about: Simulation recordings: every video in docs/recordings/, listed on media.html by scripts/build-pages.py. check-docs.py fails on an mp4 under docs/ that no page or this list shows. Each: file, poster, title, what it shows, the command that made it, the branch it was made on, and the date.

recordings.title: One face, four robots
recordings.what: One face capture from a webcam, played to LexJR, the pan tilt, the rover and the rover pan tilt: the same gamerobotd and behaviours on four bodies, captioned and narrated.

recordings.title: Rover pan tilt: a face circling, coming in and going out
recordings.what: A synthetic face circles while coming in to 35 cm and out to 85 cm, with natural pace, drift and sway, 25% nearer than the path. The head glances at it, the base turns after it and drives to keep its distance. Fixed camera, three-quarter view from behind.
recordings.command: bin/gamerobotics play roverpt --faces circle-in-out --face-natural --face-distance 0.75 --seconds 45 --record docs/recordings/roverpt-natural-fixed.mp4 --record-camera fixed

recordings.title: Rover pan tilt: a face circling, fixed camera
recordings.what: A synthetic face goes round a 50 x 30 cm circle every 8 s, 25% nearer than the path. The camera stays where the robot started, so the motion on screen is the robot's.
recordings.command: bin/gamerobotics play roverpt --faces circle --face-distance 0.75 --seconds 30 --record docs/recordings/roverpt-circle-fixed.mp4 --record-camera fixed

recordings.title: Rover pan tilt: a face circling, over its shoulder
recordings.what: The same circling face, filmed by a camera that follows the robot over its shoulder toward the face.
